reason: Design-only: adds an instance to 02-instrument-blindness recording that a complete, accurate `make gate` run certifies the WORKING TREE and not the branch tip, so a green report made with an uncommitted file describes content nobody else can reach. Found when a coordinator ran `git status` before merging rather than after; the uncommitted file was the decision index. Not a silent match — the instruments were correct about the wrong subject. No code change.
